User.title: User
User.description: Represents a user in the system, with a specific profile.

id.description: Unique identifier for the User entity, from Firebase Auth.

email.description: Email address for login and communication.

active.description: Indicates if the user account is active.

School.title: School
School.description: Represents a school within the system.

id.description: Unique identifier for the School entity.

Parent.title: Parent
Parent.description: Represents a parent or guardian of a student.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Parent entity.

userId.description: Reference to the User entity for login details.

Student.title: Student
Student.description: Represents a student in the system.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Student entity.

status.description: The boarding status of the student.

monthlyFee.description: The monthly transportation fee for the student.

Driver.title: Driver
Driver.description: Represents a driver of a vehicle.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Driver entity.

userId.description: Reference to the User entity for login details.

Vehicle.title: Vehicle
Vehicle.description: Represents a vehicle in the fleet.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Vehicle entity.

active.description: Indicates if the vehicle is in operation.

Route.title: Route
Route.description: Represents a route for transporting students.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Route entity.

studentIds.description: Ordered references to Students for the route stops.

turnByTurnDirections.description: A list of turn-by-turn navigation instructions for the route.

lastOptimizedAt.description: Timestamp of the last time the route was optimized by AI.

Invoice.title: Invoice
Invoice.description: Represents an invoice for a student's transportation services.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Invoice entity.

parentUserId.description: The auth UID of the parent responsible for this invoice.

description.description: Description of the invoice item (e.g., 'Mensalidade', 'Viagem Avulsa').

Message.title: Message
Message.description: Represents a message between users (parents, drivers, monitors, admins).

id.description: Unique identifier for the Message entity.

senderId.description: Identifier of the sender (user ID from Firebase Auth).

recipientId.description: Identifier of the recipient (user ID from Firebase Auth).

timestamp.description: Timestamp of when the message was sent.

AuthorizedPickup.title: Authorized Pickup
AuthorizedPickup.description: Represents a person authorized to pick up a student.

id.description: Unique identifier for the authorized person.

studentId.description: The ID of the student this person is authorized for.

parentUserId.description: The auth UID of the parent who owns this record.

name.description: Full name of the authorized person.

phone.description: Contact phone number of the authorized person.

TripRequest.title: Trip Request
TripRequest.description: Represents a request from a parent for a one-off trip for a student.

id.description: Unique identifier for the trip request.

studentId.description: The ID of the student for this request.

parentUserId.description: The auth UID of the parent who made the request.

schoolId.description: Reference to the School entity for the trip's destination.

date.description: The specific date for the requested trip.

shift.description: The shift for the requested trip.

status.description: The current status of the request.

reason.description: Optional reason or notes for the request.

createdAt.description: Timestamp of when the request was created.

amount.description: The cost of the trip, to be approved by the parent.

Stop.title: Stop
Stop.description: Represents a stop along a route

id.description: Unique identifier for the Stop entity.

LocationUpdate.title: Location Update
LocationUpdate.description: Represents a real-time location update for a driver.

ContractTemplate.title: Contract Template
ContractTemplate.description: Represents a reusable contract template that can be used to generate individual contracts for students.

name.description: The name of the template (e.g., 'Contrato Padrão 2024').

content.description: The full text content of the contract, with placeholders like {{aluno_nome}}.

createdAt.description: Timestamp of when the template was created.

Contract.title: Contract
Contract.description: Represents a specific, generated contract for a student, linked to a parent.

id.description: Unique identifier for the generated contract.

studentId.description: The ID of the student this contract is for.

parentUserId.description: The auth UID of the parent responsible for this contract.

generatedContent.description: The final contract content with all variables filled in.

status.description: The current status of the contract.

acceptedAt.description: Timestamp of when the parent accepted the contract.

createdAt.description: Timestamp of when the contract was generated.

firestore.reasoning:
The Firestore data structure is designed to support the 'Rota Segura Mobile' application, focusing on real-time incident reporting, route optimization, and communication. The design prioritizes Authorization Independence by denormalizing authorization data where necessary. It utilizes structural segregation to maintain a homogeneous security posture within collections. Access Modeling follows consistent patterns for user-owned data and collaborative scenarios.

**Authorization Independence:**

*   For entities where authorization depends on parent data, like messages between parents and the system, the relevant authorization context (e.g., parent ID, system ID) is included directly within each message document. This avoids `get()` calls in security rules and enables atomic operations.
*   For collaborative entities like routes, the `driverId` is denormalized to allow direct association and simplified security rules.

**Structural Segregation:**

*   Data with different access requirements are stored in separate collections. For example, global roles for admins are stored in `/roles_admin/{uid}` rather than mixing admin and non-admin user data in a single `/users` collection.
*   User-specific data, like parent-student messages, is stored within a hierarchical path (`/users/{userId}/messages/{messageId}`) to ensure clear ownership and simplified security rules.

**Access Modeling:**

*   Private data is managed using path-based ownership (e.g., `/users/{userId}/invoices/{invoiceId}`).
*   User-owned data is organized hierarchically (e.g., `/users/{userId}/routes/{routeId}`).
*   Collaborative data (if any) would typically use a membership map (`members: {uid1: "role", uid2: "role"}`), but it's not explicitly needed in the current feature set. If future features require it (e.g., shared routes), this model should be implemented.

**QAPs (Rules are not Filters):**

*   The structure enables secure `list` operations by ensuring all documents within a collection share the same security requirements. For example, listing routes is secure because only authorized users can access the `/routes` collection, and all documents within that collection adhere to the same authorization rules (e.g., admin access). The alternative is to implement filtering in security rules, which is avoided.
